heading: Today
text: Numerous showers from I-89 west and south.  Maybe a glimpse of sun northeast, a passing morning shower, then showers increasing northeast this afternoon, in eastern Quebec by evening.  Highs in the 70s, upper 60s in the Adirondacks.  Winds southeast, becoming east, up to 10 mph north, 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph south.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of showers, tapering off through NY and the St. Lawrence Valley.  Lows in the 50s to near 60.  Winds east near 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph south in the evening, diminishing late.

heading: Thursday
text: Showers likely from the Green Mountains east, decreasing west.  Breaks of afternoon sun in the St. Lawrence into the Adirondacks, with a chance of a few showers.  Highs in the low to mid 70s.  Winds east up to 10 mph, becoming light.
